none: PAS NLM-92D807: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine I
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus, probably of Constantine I (306-337); the reverse, which is worn to the point of near-extinction, appears to show two figures with something between them, which leaves the identification in doubt. The size of flan and obverse title should indicate an issue of Reece period 16, 317-330. Obverse description: bull-necked bust laureate right, seen from behind with prominent shoulder, probably cuirassed. Obverse inscription: IMP CONSTANTINVS[---]. Reverse description: possibly two or more figures; appears rubbed down. Diameter: 21.9mm, Weight: 2.19gms, die axis: possibly 6
